name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1884: He asked whether every single item had been simulated through the routing and whether the traffic had been tested at three to five hundred, and the answer was no. The existing suite has 21 good tests and every one of them calls the gate or the merge directly, so the routing inside the sweep had never been executed at all. The new battery drives the real sweep over real reel directories: his whole roster lands, one session owns nothing, every surface files into its own lane, the throw bar holds at two recordings and clears at three, five hundred items land with none dropped, and a thousand rows of one item stay one row. Seen red three ways. No defect found.
